subject: Pilot perk extension & one-time credit waiver — EmberLabs
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@emberlabs.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot perk extension + one-time supplemental credits

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the help so far — EmberLabs' cohort onboarding hit a timing issue (delayed infra approvals at our partner school), and the demo window is now pushed two weeks later. We were originally scheduled to start using Redwood credits this week; because of the shift, our engineers will only be ramped for the demo week.

Could Redwood grant a one-time supplemental credit allocation to bridge the gap so we can keep the cohort demo momentum? Specifically we're asking for a 20k token-equivalent credit top-up (roughly $8k list) and a 30-day extension on our current 90-day pilot window. If possible, we'd also like to lock the upgraded allocation to the EmberLabs demo project so the usage doesn't cannibalize other internal tests.

Context: attached is a short metrics export (pilot_metrics.pdf) showing expected demo traffic and the team deck (team_deck_v2.pptx) with the cohort list. The demo is now scheduled for June 9; having the buffer credit and extension would make the difference between a successful public demo and rescheduling again.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to review the ask. Appreciate any flexibility here — EmberLabs is a strong fit for our Founders Partner program and we hope to convert to a paid plan post-demo.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships, EmberLabs
samira@emberlabs.ai
